offering_description.value: Sells a go-to-market intelligence platform with B2B contact and company data, plus sales and marketing workflow tools. Customers are sales, marketing and revenue teams at businesses, delivered mainly as software subscriptions.

primary_products.value: B2B contact and company data; go-to-market intelligence platform; sales engagement software; marketing automation tools

primary_services.value: data enrichment; customer onboarding and training; professional services

customer_segment.value: B2B: sales, marketing and revenue operations teams at companies of many sizes

end_markets.value: technology; financial services; professional services; manufacturing; healthcare

revenue_model.value: subscription: annual or multi-year access to data and software platform; service fees: onboarding, implementation and training for enterprise customers

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: collects and processes business data into a platform sold to sales and marketing teams; service provider: provides data enrichment and customer support services to business clients

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia Pacific and other regions, headquartered in the US

specialization.value: niche specialist: one go-to-market intelligence platform with its data, engagement and marketing tools

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: enterprise sales teams selling to large business accounts; online: self-serve web access and online sign-up for smaller customers; partners / resellers: technology partners and integrations with CRM and sales software platforms

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: data privacy rules such as GDPR and CCPA govern collection and use of business contact data
